facts.text: Grand Hyatt San Francisco is a downtown high-rise hotel on Union Square.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the city on Union Square, our downtown high rise hotel

facts.text: The hotel is minutes from Chinatown, Golden Gate Theatre and Hayes Valley.
facts.excerpt: minutes away from key attractions and iconic landmarks such as Chinatown, Golden Gate Theatre, Hayes Valley and Union Square

facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows in each room look out on Union Square, the bay or the city.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows in each room offer unbeatable Union Square, bay or city views.

facts.text: Bay View rooms are on the 19th floor or higher.
facts.excerpt: floor-to-ceiling windows with bay views from the 19th floor or higher

facts.text: Suites have a separate living area and hardwood floors.
facts.excerpt: Suites feature more space with a separate living area as well as hardwood floors for an elegant stay.

facts.text: The Luxury Suite on the 34th floor has a kitchenette, a sauna, a soaking tub and floor-to-ceiling city views.
facts.excerpt: kitchenette, sauna, soaking tub, hardwood floors and floor-to-ceiling city views from the 34th floor

facts.text: The Deluxe Suite on the 33rd floor has a large wet bar and San Francisco Bay views.
facts.excerpt: 655-square-foot suite on the 33rd floor, with a king bed, hardwood floors, separate living area, large wet bar and stunning San Francisco Bay views

facts.text: The Bayview Residence is a two-bedroom apartment with a full kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Make yourself at home inside this two-bedroom, 1,250-square-foot apartment offering a full kitchen

facts.text: From the 22nd floor, the Bayview Residence looks over San Francisco Bay and the Financial District.
facts.excerpt: From the 22nd floor, this spacious residence features remarkable San Francisco Bay and Financial District views.

facts.text: Club Access rooms include the Grand Club lounge, which serves free breakfast and snacks.
facts.excerpt: access to our Grand Club lounge serving free breakfast, snacks and other amenities.

facts.text: Rooms have Balmain bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Balmain bath amenities

facts.text: The 24-hour StayFit fitness center is on the 35th floor, with floor-to-ceiling windows and views over the city and bay.
facts.excerpt: 35th-floor facility features floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping views of the City by the Bay

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour StayFit fitness center

facts.text: The concierge desk has a map of scenic jogging routes.
facts.excerpt: map highlighting scenic jogging routes, available from the concierge desk.

facts.text: The hotel's wedding venues include a top-floor reception area with panoramic views of San Francisco Bay.
facts.excerpt: a top-floor reception area featuring panoramic views of San Francisco Bay.

facts.text: OneUP Restaurant serves a buffet breakfast of American classics.
facts.excerpt: Start your day with our delicious American classics, served buffet-style for a satisfying breakfast experience.

facts.text: OneUP Lounge, on the Mezzanine Level, serves wines, cocktails and savory bites.
facts.excerpt: Located on the Mezzanine Level, OneUP Lounge is the perfect spot to gather with friends, family, or colleagues. Enjoy fine wines, crafted cocktails, and savory bites in a stylish setting.

facts.text: Self-parking is in the Sutter-Stockton Garage at 444 Stockton Street, not at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Covered self-parking is available for our guests, located at Sutter-Stockton Garage, 444 Stockton Street.

facts.text: Guests bringing a dog must tell the hotel at least three days before arrival.
facts.excerpt: Please inform the hotel at least three days before arrival

facts.text: Most Union Square View king rooms have a tub-and-shower combination, while some have only a walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: Majority of rooms have a bathtub and shower combination, some are walk-in shower only.

facts.text: The hotel has four event venues with over 30,000 square feet of meeting space.
facts.excerpt: 4 unique event venues totaling over 30,000 square feet of meeting space
